### The Slippery Slope of Comfort
Author: David Jeremiah
Site: DavidJeremiah.org
URL: https://www.davidjeremiah.org/forward-experience/the-slippery-slope-of-comfort?devdate=2021-01-29
Passage: Revelation 3:1-3
Points:
- Outward success and active church programs can disguise inner spiritual deadness and complacency.
- Believers must maintain watchful vigilance against sin rather than resting on past achievements.
- Walking in the power of the Holy Spirit prevents spiritual stagnation and transforms daily worship.
- God’s people are called to submit to Scripture and hold tightly to biblical truth.
- Honest confession and genuine repentance serve as God's unchanging path to spiritual renewal.

### Spiritual Resuscitation
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B230712/spiritual-resuscitation
Passage: Revelation 3:1-3
Points:
- Churches can keep up a pious appearance while remaining blind to their own spiritual decay.
- Christ commands believers to shake off lethargy, wake up, and honestly face their condition.
- Christians must work to preserve and strengthen whatever genuine faith and virtue still survive.
- Reviving a dying church requires remembering apostolic gospel truth and actively obeying it.
- Refusing to confess sin and repent invites sudden, unexpected divine judgment.
